description: Represents a file or folder item in the file manager.

members.name: IconName
members.description: Icon name override. When null, the file manager chooses based on extension.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier of the item (full path or GUID).

members.name: IsDirectory
members.description: Whether this item is a directory.

members.name: IsSelected
members.description: Whether the item is currently selected.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name of the file or folder.

members.name: Size
members.description: File size in bytes. Null for directories.
